title: Grundy Total Domination and Skew Zero Forcing in Cartesian Products of Paths and Cycles
summary: We determine the Grundy total domination number and the skew zero forcing number for every Cartesian product of two paths or cycles, thereby closing the nonmatching bounds previously known for these rectangular, cylindrical, and toroidal families. For $2\le a\le b$, \[ Z_-(P_a\square P_b) =a-\mathbf1_{\{a\ {\rm odd},\,b\ {\rm even}\}}. \] For $p\ge2$ and $c\ge3$, \[ Z_-(P_p\square C_c)= \begin{cases} \min\{p,c\},&c\text{ is odd}, \min\{2p,c\},&c\text{ is even}. \end{cases} \] Finally, for $3\le a\le b$, \[ Z_-(C_a\square C_b)= \begin{cases} 2a-1,&a=b\text{ odd}, 2a,&a=b\text{ even},…
